children: Switzerland energy and infrastructure operator's H1 2026 operating income fell 3.1% yr/yr
H1 net profit rose 7% yr/yr, driven by nuclear decommissioning fund performance
Company expects 2026 EBIT at lower end of target range due to challenging conditions
BKW expects 2026 EBIT at the lower end of CHF 650 mln to CHF 750 mln target range
Company anticipates stronger H2 for Infrastructure & Buildings and Energy Solutions segments
Power Grid segment is likely to remain stable in the second half of 2026
ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS - Co said low water levels and weak winds reduced electricity production in H1
MARKET DISRUPTIONS - Co said Energy Solutions segment was temporarily impacted by market disruptions linked to the situation in the Middle East
HEDGING BENEFIT - Electricity volumes for 2026 had been hedged at high futures market prices, supporting Energy Solutions segment
DECOMMISSIONING FUND GAINS – Strong performance by Mühleberg's decommissioning and waste-disposal funds lifted net profit 7.0% to CHF 217.6 mln
Sept 8 - French energy unions threaten strikes next week over proposal to curb benefits, pay
